summary.text: Aric Putnam is a Democratic state senator from Minnesota who represents District 14 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Republican Bernie Perryman.
He is a college professor who took office in January 2021.

paragraphs.text: Putnam assumed office in the Minnesota State Senate on January 5, 2021, succeeding Jerry Relph (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, Putnam said he grew up in California, lives in central Minnesota, and teaches and researches at St. John's University, where he has been a teacher for 25 years.
Putnam listed fighting fraud, lowering costs and lowering health care costs as the key messages of his 2026 campaign.

He said he authored the bill creating the Office of the Inspector General, helped craft a 2023 tax cut, and championed the bill that opened a University of Minnesota Medical School campus in St. Cloud.
Putnam also said he sponsored the Hunger Free Campus act, one of his first pieces of legislation.
